rule_contract.information: exact same actual current forecast_evidence as C11
rule_contract.candidate_contract: same plan-independent a_ref versus one patch; other baseline allocations retained
rule_contract.objective: mean over 300/900/1800 of integral positive(visible_waiting + cumulative_B1_mean - planning_available_trays), plus candidate tray-unavailable seconds and observed path resource pressure seconds
rule_contract.action_effect: transfer removes source tray at current commitment; adds destination tray only at earliest_departure plus public static travel; hold keeps it at source
rule_contract.existing_commitment_eta: remaining time conservatively starts a full public trip at max(now, earliest_departure), since original physical progress is not attested by an ACK-only ledger; unreachable commitments are retained as unknown without predicted supply
rule_contract.resource_proxy: candidate unavailable seconds capped at 1800, plus observed node occupancy/capacity times service and visible edge occupancy/capacity times travel; absent capacity or pressure is explicitly unknown
supply_terms: own immutable request payloads with actually delivered committed ACK
same retained uncommitted baseline batch allocations
rule_contract.missing_scope: unknown accounts stay flagged; objective is an observed-account conditional proxy, not total actual deficit; no private stock or future-arrival oracle
rule_contract.strong_rule_basis: existing analytic FIFO/min-stock matching and service-aware notified-fault paths, augmented by source/destination B1 demand and commitment-aware marginal cost
rule_contract.calibration: fixed engineering units before test; no outcome-based tuning
limitations: conditional supplies and static arrival estimates may fail or be delayed
remote account and occupancy coverage may be incomplete
shared-resource per-job protection remains the external native/guard responsibility

information_contract: The identical actual controller-preload forecast receipt supplied to C11. Offline reconstructed retrospective evidence is rejected.
frozen_rationale: Use the existing analytic rule for FIFO/min-stock/R1, shared static opportunity catalog, recovery and mandatory retained batch.
All three prespecified service horizons are equally weighted; unit shortage and tray-occupation seconds avoid target-selected scaling.
Future B1 source demand is an opportunity cost; destination cumulative demand may justify arrival-before-demand transfers.
Known own delivered-ACK commitments, current local unload/hold releases and retained baseline allocations reduce duplicate predicted supply need.
This conditional observed-account rule is a strong bounded heuristic, not a claim of optimal control or complete accounts.
limitations: Current dataset does not attest remote complete inventories or arrivals; unknowns remain reported.
One-use inventory approximation omits repeated future tray cycles.
Existing ACK-only committed transfer ETA conservatively restarts a full static trip from now because exact progress is unavailable.
Shared-resource per-job nonharm is not certified.
Runtime must separately bind all imported controller and forecast source bytes to its prepared run.
